name: Heuristic transform review without a contract returns to design

turns.user: You must review a Cypher rewriter that detects and transforms unsafe identifiers. It is high-risk semantic behavior. There is no approved behavior contract for what counts as unsafe. State what you do before judging the implementation.

rubric: The assistant refuses to certify the heuristic transform because high-risk semantic behavior has no approved contract.
It returns to designing-changes to establish the behavior contract before review.
For a parser, rewriter, or validator it requires reviewers to derive an attack matrix from the contract before judging the implementation.
It does not treat the current detector or fix as correct while priming reviewers.
